column2: 使用 skills/goai-ref-guard/SKILL.md 处理终审 issues I15、I17、I18，仅修改综述正文引用与审计产物，不改 references.bib 元数据。先读取并核对 /home/gaojing/goai_synthesis_runs/20260903_synthesis_topics/01_llzo/drafts/sections/06_transport_measurement.tex 与 07_interfaces_integration.tex 中 wang2025computational、anon2025decision 的语境；移除 wang2025computational 的 LLTO 误用（若保留只能在同句明确 LLTO comparator 且不得把它当 LLZO 证据），并将 anon2025decision decision letter 误称 scalable-cathode report 的论据删除、改为不依赖该来源的表述或换用 references.bib 中已 PASS 的正式 LLZO 论文。运行 verify_entry/bib_guard，确保所有正文 key 在 references.bib 且 I15/I17 证据边界清楚。重新生成与当前正文完全同步的 /home/gaojing/goai_synthesis_runs/20260903_synthesis_topics/01_llzo/state/CITATION_AUDIT.json 与 .md（更新正文 unique key、citation counts、orphan 数、context_remediation；不要声称已移除仍存在的键）。运行 tex_guard、academic_language_guard，更新 ref_guard 日志并用 loopctl 关闭 I15/I17/I18；不要修改 PDF 或图件。关键产物：/home/gaojing/goai_synthesis_runs/20260903_synthesis_topics/01_llzo/state/CITATION_AUDIT.json,/home/gaojing/goai_synthesis_runs/20260903_synthesis_topics/01_llzo/state/CITATION_AUDIT.md,/home/gaojing/goai_synthesis_runs/20260903_synthesis_topics/01_llzo/drafts/sections/06_transport_measurement.tex,/home/gaojing/goai_synthesis_runs/20260903_synthesis_topics/01_llzo/drafts/sections/07_interfaces_integration.tex
